environment.runtime: x64 Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 console in a Hyper-V-isolated container
environment.candidate: GNU-target x64 build in the same console environment
environment.fixtures: 31 independently assembled LLVM MC 23.1.6 rows and hand-encoded boundary and displacement probes. Raw slots use 90 padding.

formatting.x87: FADD displays st(0),st(1) in the selected fixture. FLD displays its explicit stack operand.
formatting.repeat_and_lock: F3-prefixed string examples show rep and a width-specific mnemonic. LOCK ADD shows a byte, word, or doubleword size tag in the operand color.
formatting.displacements: Values below ten use a single digit. Larger magnitudes show a leading zero and the encoded field width. An encoded zero has its own [0] cell. Address-size overrides affect the displayed width of absolute memory operands.

paired_checks.comparison: At the same 120-column terminal dimensions, the selected rows match opcode bytes, mnemonic and operand cells, and the colors on nonblank instruction cells.

reference_search.comparison: Both programs found the branch after the C5 rejection and the F8 row.

limits: The observations cover selected encodings. The original shows an LDS operand for a lone C5 at EOF. The candidate reports truncated input and preserves the raw byte. Newer-extension boundary differences in 32-bit and 64-bit Decode remain open.
